text.tspan: One point per task after all 50 are learned; the heavy rule is the median. Both panels are the same runs.
A random policy already collects most of the raw return here, so raw scores crowd into [0.59, 0.99] and the methods look closer than they are.
The random floor also varies per task, from 0.55 to 0.87, so the same raw number is a different achievement on different tasks.
Normalising against each task's own floor is what makes them comparable. Ours is 3 complete seeds, the others 1 each.
